text: Gukesh held Sindarov to a draw with Black in Game 1 of the world championship, with Game 2 starting at 9 AM New York time today.
England chased 185 in 13.1 overs on the Gold Coast to beat Australia in the second T20I and level the series.
Mahomes' Chiefs visit Allen's Bills on Thanksgiving night in a game Sky Sports calls the NFL's biggest of the season.
Charley Hull lost her WTGL debut for Atlanta Drive to Lottie Woad's Boston Common but said she had a great laugh.
Arthur Rinderknech denies refusing an anti-doping test after the charge against the French player was confirmed, and expects to be cleared.
The Players Championship Finals run 27 to 29 November in Minehead without Luke Littler, Nathan Aspinall or Josh Rock; Stephen Bunting opens against Max Hopp.
Kansas City Current beat Washington Spirit 2-1 to win their first NWSL title, Debinha scoring in stoppage time.
Tyson Fury fights Anthony Joshua at Cardiff's Principality Stadium on 11 December, streaming live on Netflix.
